notes.group:reset-oil-service-reminder: provenance: CarScannerMaui.Coding.DB.MQB.Service.decompiled.cs Service.ResetOilService(). Unit 17 (714/77E). Item1 DID 2243: on EnableOption every byte of the record is set to 0 (for i<array.Length array[i]=0); encoded as a fill op {byte:0,len:8,value:0,fill:true} that zeroes every byte of the record as read (3 bytes per csadapt-10046, but whatever length the cluster returns). Item2 DID 2244: every byte = 0; same fill op (2 bytes per csadapt-10047). Item3 DID 2232: array[0]=0 (csadapt-10045 state 'Reset'=0). Single option 'Start' -> group choice 'start'. Password: vendor says not required (hint MQB 20103); left null so pipeline backfills unit-17 default 47115 (needed live on the 6JM920310 cluster).
notes.group:reset-inspection-service-reminder: provenance: CarScannerMaui.Coding.DB.MQB.Service.decompiled.cs Service.ResetInspectionService(). Unit 17. DID 22A6: array[0]=0, array[1]=0 (distance since last inspection, x100 km). DID 22A7: array[0]=0, array[1]=0 (days since last inspection). Single option 'Start' -> group choice 'start'. Password null -> unit default.
notes.svc:inspection-service-distance: provenance: carscanner-candidates.json mqbadaptations.db adaptations csadapt-10014 (17/22A4 Max Distance Until Next Mileage Related Inspection, 2 bytes x100 km) and csadapt-10070 (17/22D5 Reset Value For Next Mileage Dependent Inspection, 2 bytes x100 km). Both written with the same value so the current countdown and the value reloaded on reset agree. Choice value is the physical km (raw = km/100).
notes.svc:inspection-service-interval: provenance: csadapt-10067 (17/22A5 Max Time Until Next Time Dependent Inspection, 2 bytes days) + csadapt-10071 (17/22D6 Reset Value For Next Time Dependent Inspection, days). Same value to both.
notes.svc:oil-change-service-distance: provenance: csadapt-10063 (17/2246 Maximum Distance Between Service, x100 km), csadapt-10064 (17/2245 Minimum Distance Between Service, x100 km), csadapt-10134 (17/22A0 Maximum Distance To Service, x100 km). VW cluster computes the due point between min and max, so a fixed interval needs min = max; 22A0 is the upper clamp and must be >= the interval, so all three get the same value. 2026-11-03 audit: added km-25000 (raw 250) because the Kylaq and Virtus cards list 7,500/10,000/15,000/20,000/25,000/30,000 km; the other choices are unchanged.
notes.svc:oil-change-service-interval: provenance: csadapt-10065 (17/2247 Maximum Time Between Service, days), csadapt-10066 (17/2293 Minimum Time Between Service, days), csadapt-10112 (17/22A1 Maximum Value Of Time To Service, days). min = max = clamp, as for distance.
notes.csadapt-10194: provenance: mqbadaptations.db Adaptation@710:2A31 byte1 (battery technology enum Wet=0, FleeceAgm=1, Efb=7 ...). Name was a Russian placeholder; renamed. Shares DID 2A31 with csadapt-10133 (byte0 capacity); each write is read-modify-write of the record so they do not clobber each other.
notes.csadapt-10133: provenance: mqbadaptations.db Adaptation@710:2A31 (vt1/dl1/sbi0) Battery Capacity Ah, byte0, 1 byte x1. Presets = catalogue options 44..72 Ah; free value also valid (1..255).
notes.csadapt-10113: provenance: mqbadaptations.db Adaptation@714:2248 Oil Quality byte0 (NA=0, Poor=1, Good=2). Catalogue Regular (fixed interval) = Poor, LongLife (flexible) = Good.
notes.csadapt-10006: WARNING kept per verified mapping: Adaptation@712:1922 on unit 44 (EPS, pw 19249) IncrementalControlledOverTime=0 / DirectControlledOverThresholdValue=1. Matches Carista Kushaq "Throttle response behavior" wording, but sibling 1920 is the drive-mode steering characteristic, so the effect may be steering-side. No unit-01 pedal map recipe exists in the corpus or C#. 2026-11-03 audit: the 44 option names match the community 'Driving profile switchover' channel (Incremental controlled over time / Direct controlled over threshold value, login 19249; vag-coding Kamiq NW, REMAINING_FEATURES increased-engine-responsiveness), which is the tweak sold as throttle response. Bytes are vendor-exact (1922 byte0, 0/1); the engine-side effect is unverified.
